campaign_name: PR-BR Continuation 14 — Resolution-Content Preservation & Authoritative Best-Candidate Emission
purpose: Require a later candidate to preserve the resolution content of the current best safe answer, and make that best answer the emitted line unless it is explicitly invalidated. Six focused live turns. No smoke. No 4x10 gate. PR-BR remains open.
executive_summary: Equal rank is no longer enough to replace a safe answer. Procedure, use, and confidence each keep their own resolution on the six recorded Continuation 13 replays. Deterministic band: 316 passed, 0 failed. Live turns: 6. Interpretation calls: 3. Generation calls: 6. Evaluator model calls: 0. Retries: 0. Correct contracts 5/6. Initial manual PASS 6/6. Final manual PASS 4/6. Semantic degradations 2. best_safe emission mismatches 0. Evaluator PASS 4/6 with 1 false PASS and 1 false FAIL. READY FOR INDEPENDENT 10-TURN SMOKE: NO. READY FOR FULL SYNTHETIC GATE: NO. HUMAN PLAYTEST: NOT AUTHORIZED. HEAD d31beb7d73dd4fda0f22184a6a69b947b5f470ff, uncommitted.

game/playability_eval.py fails a satisfied line that does not cover the contract dimensions.
game/perception_grounding.py and game/narration_state_consistency.py invalidate a candidate that grounding replaced, without discarding a social answer that already resolves the contract.
game/api_turn_support.py does not replace a referenced-surface or perception grounding line with the contract fallback.
validation: tests/test_pr_br_continuation14_resolution_content.py replays all six Continuation 13 turns and covers equal-rank, superset, authority, and evaluator fixtures.
